systems.name: 3.1 ZScript Parser / Compiler
systems.notes: Implement a ZScript parser that can read .zs files from PK3 and convert them into an intermediate representation suitable for the runtime.
tasks: Lexer and parser for ZScript syntax
Parse classes, structs, enums, and constants
Handle inheritance, virtual functions, and flags
Translate ZScript into runtime bytecode or GDScript

systems.name: 3.2 ZScript Runtime Integration
systems.notes: Execute ZScript logic within the Godot scene tree. Replace or augment existing actors with ZScript-defined behaviour.
tasks: Instantiate ZScript actors in place of DECORATE actors
Call ZScript virtual functions (BeginPlay, Tick, etc.)
Access game data (players, level, RNG) from ZScript

systems.name: 3.3 Actor Class Replacement
systems.notes: Allow ZScript to replace built-in actor classes (player, monster, weapon).
tasks: Replace native classes with ZScript subclasses

systems.name: 3.4 DECORATE ↔ ZScript Compatibility
systems.notes: Ensure smooth interop between DECORATE-defined actors and ZScript actors. Shared state, inheritance, and function calling.
tasks: DECORATE actors can inherit from ZScript classes
Shared damage, inventory, and state systems
